name: Habu Momoko
source:
Area: Shiga Prefecture

A woman working at a soapland. Because of her naturally beautiful appearance she finds her job easy. Despite her slightly airheaded personality, she is the most popular worker at the workplace, and embraces her title as the "Soap Queen" fully.
